offering_description.value: Provides site development, foundation, paving and civil construction services for data centers, transportation projects and commercial and industrial buildings across the US. Wins contracts through bids to public agencies and negotiated work with private developers, then performs the work with its own crews and equipment.

primary_services.value: site work and underground utilities; deep foundations; highway and bridge construction; concrete paving; parking structures

customer_segment.value: B2B: data center developers, commercial and industrial developers, general contractors; B2G: state departments of transportation, cities and counties, public authorities

end_markets.value: data centers; transportation infrastructure; commercial and industrial construction; water and utilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and unit-price construction contracts paid for completed project work

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs construction work, taking in project contracts and selling completed infrastructure to owners and developers

geography_served.value: US national: projects in multiple US states, with a strong presence in Texas, the Southwest, the Southeast and the Midwest

specialization.value: related lines: e-infrastructure (data center sitework and foundations), transportation infrastructure, and building solutions for commercial and industrial sites

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids to public agencies and negotiated contracts with private owners and developers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, prevailing wage and public procurement rules, environmental and worker safety rules such as OSHA

notes: Segment names, customer mix and state footprint are from general knowledge and may have changed.
